visual_review.review_method: Assistant visual comparison of rendered PDF pages with stored source text; not independent human expert certification

pages.observation: Visual checklist conditions and ownership distinctions are present in text. New/renewal headings coexist on this page; uniform windows can span that boundary.
Representative authority, notarization and newly-designated condition preserved in text; no claim of complete service checklist within top K.

Fee labels and amounts are preserved but the first multi-line cell is extracted as a list of labels followed by a list of amounts, weakening row associations. The Ice Crusher rate is visibly incomplete in the PDF (P 10.00 per); do not invent its unit.
Occupancy definition and checklist text match visible page, including unusual source-listed Certificate of Occupancy requirement. Preserve source wording rather than silently correcting policy.
Action substeps 2.1-2.4 and their times are in separate text runs; vertical table associations are lost in plain-text serialization.
Multiple inspection substeps and repeated durations are flattened into separate runs. Text preservation alone cannot establish the corresponding row.
Release wording and printed total preserved. Blank/merged table cells must not be filled by inference.
Three-storey-and-above scope, CPDO definition, requirements and where-to-secure text preserved.
Two-storey-and-below scope and ownership alternatives retained; checklist continues beyond this page.
Face-to-face business scope, conditions and additional-requirements note retained.
Online business scope retained; visible Client responsibility and source row numbering preserved as printed.

Graphical dot matrix associates requirements with six service columns. Plain text does not reliably encode those applicability relationships. Large poster also contains image-only material; text-layer equality is insufficient.

open_findings.issue: Row and column associations are weakened by block-text linearization.
open_findings.required_followup: Source-coordinate table serialization and visual verification before final freeze.

open_findings.issue: Graphical requirement applicability matrix is not faithfully represented by plain text.
open_findings.required_followup: Explicit source-verified matrix transcription with column identities and dot membership; no guessed requirements.

visual_review.policy: Do not certify the complete corpus or silently invent table relationships. Preserve evidence and keep integration in development mode.

limitation: Text-layer preservation does not prove row/column associations, graphics extraction, or correct reading order. Development integration only.
